item.title: Fertigation System
item.description: What is a Fertigation System? A fertigation system integrates irrigation and fertilizer delivery into one automated platform. PKYDrip’s fertigation units allow precise nutrient mixing, automatic scheduling, and multi-zone irrigation control with support for EC/pH monitoring and cloud connectivity.
